text:
emma: Quick thread — thinking about hedging & fallback heuristics on the console query plane for dashboard requests. We keep hitting a tail of 3–5% slow responses and current plan (canary -> fallback to smaller projection) has gaps. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
raj: Do you mean hedging (send to two lanes) or gradual degrade (reduce widgets)?
emma: both. Hedging to cheaper pool vs degrade to precomputed snapshot. Want rules that minimize cost blowup while keeping P99.
tera: P99 target is 450ms, cost budget per request ~0.8 tokens-equivalent. If hedging, we risk doubling compute for some requests.
infra-bot: alert: recent spike in slow-paths correlated with tenant Y large query fanout at 11:43 UTC
lucas: One idea: hedge only after a dynamic timeout based on recent latency percentiles per route. e.g., timeout = max(100ms, p75*1.5). Only hedge if estimated saved latency > expected extra cost.
emma: sketch config:
```yaml
hedging:
  enabled: true
  probe_delay: route.p75 * 1.5
  max_retries: 1
  allowed_pools: [fastpath, slowpath-cheap]
fallbacks:
  snapshot_age_threshold_ms: 2000
  prefer_snapshot_if_age < 60s
```
raj: That looks reasonable. Also add per-tenant budget tokens to prevent runaway cost.
tera: Also: prefer async polling for widgets that are heavy, show placeholder and stream when ready.
lucas: We should simulate with traffic replay. I can set up a short harness to compute cost delta vs p99 improvement. Want to run on canary cluster first.
emma: Agree. Also need to make RBAC implications explicit — snapshots may contain tenant-scoped sensitive fields, must respect masking rules.
raj: Good call. Add a check: snapshot-serving requires same auth token scope or deny.
tera: One more tradeoff: caching prefix/KV semantics get tricky if second worker returns with a different projection. Might pollute caches.
emma: tl;dr: proposal: dynamic timeout hedging -> single retry to cheap pool -> fallback to snapshot/degrade; per-tenant budget guardrails; simulate with replay; gate by RBAC snapshot-scope. Who can own the RFC follow-up? @lucas take infra sim, @raj add auth checks, @tera UI degrade patterns.
lucas: I can own infra sim. Will post perf numbers next week.
raj: Will draft the RBAC checklist.
tera: I'll list widgets that can safely async-degrade.
emma: cool. I'll draft a short RFC and link to sim ticket. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: created issue INFRA-3245: hedging-sim-run
lucas: FYI I'll include a small load-gen script:
```bash
# run replay
python replay.py --route dashboard.home --duration 30m --record-id 2026-03-22
```
emma: Thanks team. We'll sync in arch sync Friday if needed.
